_comment: REFERENCE FILE — not applied. This is the exact merge the runbook
(docs/plans/2026-08-31-workload-consolidation-to-aicenter.md, Phase 3) asks a human to
apply to /etc/docker/daemon.json on gda-aicenter, so the review happens on a diff in this
repo rather than on a live edit. Confirm the box's CURRENT /etc/docker/daemon.json first —
`cat /etc/docker/daemon.json` was empty/absent as of 2026-08-31 (default runtime config,
runtimes reported by `docker info` were only runc and io.containerd.runc.v2). If that file
is non-empty by the time this runs, MERGE this runtimes block into it — do not overwrite
whatever else is there.
This adds gVisor (runsc) as a NON-DEFAULT runtime, exactly the shape already proven on the
SumoPod box for this same lab-runner service (lab-runner/README.md, 'Deployed (SumoPod,
2026-08-25)'): default-runtime stays runc for every existing container (Cerbos, Keycloak,
platform-nest, etc. — none of them should ever run under gVisor, and none of them need to),
and lab-runner opts in per-container via `docker run --runtime runsc` (see
infra/systemd/gaiada-lab-runner.service and lab-runner/dist/config.js's LAB_RUNNER_RUNTIME).
APPLY (human, on the box, during a confirmed maintenance window — restarting the Docker
daemon restarts every container's PID namespace and is disruptive to a live box running 27
containers, even though `restart: unless-stopped` means compose brings them back):
1. sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates
2. curl -fsSL https://gvisor.dev/archive.key | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/gvisor-archive-keyring.gpg
3. echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/gvisor-archive-keyring.gpg] https://storage.googleapis.com/gvisor/releases release main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/gvisor.list
4. sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y runsc
5. Merge this file's `runtimes` key into /etc/docker/daemon.json (back up the original first:
sudo cp /etc/docker/daemon.json /etc/docker/daemon.json.bak-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ) — or,
if the file did not exist, note that instead so rollback knows to delete rather than restore).
6. sudo dockerd --validate --config-file /etc/docker/daemon.json   # syntax check BEFORE restart
7. sudo systemctl restart docker
8. docker info --format '{{json .Runtimes}}' | grep -o runsc   # expect a hit
9. docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'   # diff against the pre-restart baseline
(docker ps -a taken in step 0) — every gaiada-* container should be Up/healthy again
within its own start_period; none should show a NEW restart count above its baseline.
ROLLBACK: restore the timestamped .bak (or remove the file if it did not exist before),
`sudo systemctl restart docker`, re-run step 9's diff. This does not touch any container
definition or image — only the daemon's runtime registry — so a clean rollback returns the
box to exactly its pre-change state.
